metadata.dataset_name: Tanohata Kurort App - Current Walking/Course Source Dataset
metadata.scope_note: Current public course material found for Tanohata Village. No published list of Tanohata-certified Kurort health-walking courses was found; entries are existing walking, guided, geo-tourism, and candidate Kurort-compatible routes.

status_definitions.verified_from_source: Fact appears directly in a cited source.
status_definitions.inferred_for_app: Classification or recommendation tag inferred from route traits; should be reviewed by Tanohata guides/Kurort specialists.
status_definitions.unknown: Not found in public source during this pass.

courses.name_en: Geo Model Course No.1 - Cretaceous Strata, Tsunami Heritage, and Miyazawa Kenji
courses.name_ja: モデルコース No.1 白亜紀の地層と津波遺構から宮沢賢治の想いをたどる
courses.estimated_time_note: Source gives 90 minutes by private car and walking.
courses.difficulty_reason_inferred: Short duration but route is not a continuous gentle walk; includes coastal stops and transfers.
waypoints: Old Shimanokoshi Station / earthquake remains / Miyazawa Kenji poem monument
Hiraiga Fishing Port / Cretaceous strata and fossils
Tanohata Station / Miyazawa Kenji poem monument
Hiraname Coast / Cretaceous strata and fossils
Aketo Coast / earthquake remains Aketo seawall
facilities_known: tourism access by shared sightseeing taxi may support nearby points
safety_notes: Check coastal weather and footing near beaches and seawalls.
not_suitable_for_inferred: users needing a fully walkable loop

courses.name_en: Geo Model Course No.2 - Coastal Terraces and Grand-Scale Viewpoints
courses.name_ja: モデルコース No.2 高低差がある探索ポイントを巡り、壮大なスケールを満喫
courses.estimated_time_note: Source gives 180 minutes by private car and walking, including 60 minutes aboard sightseeing boat or sappa boat.
courses.difficulty_reason_inferred: Source explicitly frames the course around elevation differences and large-scale coastal topography; includes multiple dispersed points.
waypoints: Sightseeing boat or Sappa Boat Adventures / Cretaceous strata and sea caves
facilities_known: boat embarkation points depend on selected boat service
safety_notes: Boat operation depends on sea/weather conditions.
Cliff and viewpoint areas require caution.
seasonal_notes: Yamase sea fog can shape visibility and atmosphere in warmer months.
not_suitable_for_inferred: users avoiding elevation or vehicle transfers

courses.name_en: Geo Model Course No.3 - Close-Up Cretaceous Fossils
courses.name_ja: モデルコース No.3 白亜紀の化石を間近に見て、億万年の時空を体感
courses.difficulty_reason_inferred: Fully walking-based and short, but coastal geology points may include uneven shore footing.
waypoints: Haipe Coast / Cretaceous strata and fossils
Hiraiga Fishing Port / Cretaceous strata and fossils
facilities_known: Hiraiga/Raga area has nearby accommodation/settlement services, but exact toilets/rest areas need field confirmation.
safety_notes: Use caution around coastal rock surfaces, fishing port edges, and wave conditions.
Do not remove fossils or disturb geological sites without permission.
not_suitable_for_inferred: wheelchair users without confirmed accessible route
users unstable on uneven coastal surfaces

courses.name_en: Geo Model Course No.4 - People, Life, History, and Nature
courses.name_ja: モデルコース No.4 人・暮らし・歴史・自然とのふれあい
courses.estimated_time_note: Source gives 240 minutes by private car and walking.
courses.difficulty_reason_inferred: Longer multi-stop route with village, museum, bridge, coastal settlement, and nature stops.
waypoints: Kitayamazaki Visitor Center / white rhododendron colony and giant beech walk
Tashiro and Kochi districts / pasture scenery and primrose habitat
Tanohata Village Folk Museum / Sanhei Ikki and Jomon dogu
Shimanokoshi townscape / fishing village settlement scenery
safety_notes: Some route points are dispersed; field confirmation needed before presenting as a continuous walk.
Nature areas require seasonal and wildlife guidance.
seasonal_notes: White rhododendron around Kitayamazaki is noted for June-July bloom period in the geo-tourism source.
not_suitable_for_inferred: users seeking a short no-transfer walk

courses.name_en: Guided Michinoku Shiokaze Trail / Tanohata Custom Course
courses.name_ja: みちのく潮風トレイルガイド / 田野畑カスタムコース
courses.estimated_time_note: Source says courses can be set according to fitness and available time.
courses.difficulty_reason_inferred: Guide can adjust route by physical strength, time, weather, season, course, and theme.
waypoints: Michinoku Shiokaze Trail sections in Tanohata
facilities_known: NPO Tanohata Network at/near Kitayamazaki Visitor Center
accessibility_known: can be tailored, but accessible segments need guide confirmation
safety_notes: Reservation required by 17:00 the previous day; minimum two people for individual bookings.
Use local guide knowledge for weather, season, and trail choice.

pricing_known.individual: 3000 JPY per person per hour, reservation from 2 people
pricing_known.group: 10000 JPY per guide for 1 hour; 15000 JPY for 2 hours to half day; 20000 JPY for 4 hours to 1 day

seasonal_notes: Guides choose the most attractive course for weather and season.

courses.name_ja: たのはた鵜の巣断崖 波打ち際自然歩道
courses.distance_note: One way between Makisawa Coast and Shiraike Coast.
courses.estimated_time_note: One way; source warns fatigue can exceed what time/distance imply.
courses.difficulty_reason_inferred: Sand, pebble beach, rocks, tide/wave exposure, tunnels, slippery places, and possible scramble at tunnel entrances.
facilities_known: Boyokan community center is shown on map near access point
accessibility_known: not wheelchair suitable inferred; uneven shore and rocks
safety_notes: Walk only when tide and wave conditions are safe.
Iwate source reports NPO field surveys found passage is likely possible around tide level 30 cm or lower and wave height 1 m or lower, but actual conditions may differ.
Check JMA tide data for Miyako and wave forecast before walking.
High waves can make parts impassable.
Watch for slips, sprains, fatigue, falling rocks/wet rock, and tunnel entrance conditions.
seasonal_notes: Source says the period from around spring equinox to autumn equinox is generally best because daytime tide tends to be lower.

courses.distance_note: Third-party trail descriptions commonly describe the Aketo Coast-Kitayamazaki-Kurosaki natural trail as about 21 km; official Tanohata page confirms the named trail exists but does not publish this exact number on the page captured.
courses.difficulty_reason_inferred: Described as hard terrain with rocks, beaches, tunnels, stairs, and significant up/down movement.
facilities_known: parking and tourist facilities around Kitayamazaki
accessibility_known: not barrier-free inferred for full route
safety_notes: Hard route with stairs and uneven natural terrain; guide request is possible through Tanohata tourism/NPO sources.
Bear/wildlife and weather precautions should be included after local confirmation.
seasonal_notes: White rhododendron colony near Kitayamazaki/Kitayama Beach is noted for June-July bloom in the geo-tourism source.
not_suitable_for_inferred: casual older-user health walk unless shortened by a guide
